audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldowns field had no digit; two bleed bullets; both missing interactions (Prismatic Barrier absorbing the burst, Illumination auto-reset as the combo tell) were absent from the full layer; content spikes[1] called her Q cooldown '~9s' when the kit says a flat 10s.

audit.corrected: Cooldowns rewritten with the 10s Q and the shield force-out; dos bleed replaced with the Illumination wind-up tell; donts bleed replaced with the 1175/1100 range warning; spikes[1] cooldown corrected to 10s.
